  • Apoiar previsibilidade financeira dos projetos
  • Intermediar fluxo entre cliente, fornecedor e operação
  • Atuar em compras emergenciais (sim, isso vai acontecer)
  • Garantir que nada atrase por falha operacional


O ambiente (importante você saber)

  • Projetos simultâneos
  • Prazos apertados
  • Mudanças de última hora
  • Pressão real de execução

Se você gosta de rotina previsível… essa vaga não é pra você.


O perfil que buscamos

  • Organização obsessiva com detalhes
  • Rigor com processos (sem “mais ou menos”)
  • Capacidade de comunicação entre áreas
  • Senso de urgência alto
  • Conforto em ambientes dinâmicos (ou caóticos, às vezes)


Qualificações

  • Experiência prévia em rotinas de compras, financeiro ou operações
  • Organização e atenção a detalhes (fundamental)
  • Boa comunicação para interação com diferentes áreas
  • Senso de urgência e capacidade de atuar sob pressão
  • Visão de processos e melhoria contínua
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas digitais (ERP, planilhas, etc.)


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com eventos, produção ou live marketing
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis
  • Vivência com financeiro / contas a pagar / ERP (preferencialmente Omie)


Por que essa vaga é diferente?

Aqui, o impacto do seu trabalho é imediato: se o processo falha, o evento sente.

Você não está “apoiando” — você está sustentando a operação .


Quer fazer parte?

Se você gosta de resolver, organizar e garantir que as coisas aconteçam de verdade, queremos te conhecer.

A atuação precisa estar alinhada aos valores da Baggio Café: proximidade com a operação, foco em qualidade, espírito empreendedor, busca por soluções diferentes e foco no que realmente gera resultado.


Principais responsabilidades

  • Prospectar novos clientes do canal varejo na região Sul.
  • Atender e desenvolver clientes ativos, ampliando mix, volume e frequência de compra.
  • Visitar clientes estratégicos e pontos de venda, acompanhando exposição, giro, ruptura, precificação e posicionamento dos produtos.
  • Negociar condições comerciais, oportunidades de crescimento e abertura de novos pontos de venda.
  • Identificar oportunidades por cidade, região, rede, loja ou segmento.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com Inside Sales, SDR e equipe interna para organizar leads, pedidos e follow-ups.
  • Manter o CRM atualizado com visitas, negociações, status dos clientes e próximas ações.
  • Reportar informações de mercado, concorrência, preços e oportunidades regionais.
  • Representar a Baggio Café com postura profissional, proximidade, responsabilidade e foco em resultado.


Valores esperados na função

Mão na Massa

Queremos alguém próximo da operação, que vá a campo, visite clientes, entenda o ponto de venda, acompanhe a execução e resolva problemas na prática.

Qualidade Não é Negociável

A marca precisa ser bem representada. O profissional deve cuidar da forma como os produtos chegam ao cliente, como são expostos e como a Baggio Café é percebida no mercado.

Espírito Empreendedor

A região Sul ainda tem muito espaço para crescimento. Buscamos alguém com iniciativa para abrir portas, testar caminhos, encontrar oportunidades e construir mercado.

Fazer Diferente

Não buscamos apenas um vendedor que tire pedidos. Queremos alguém que pense em novas formas de desenvolver clientes, melhorar a presença da marca e gerar valor no varejo.

Foco no que Importa

A atuação deve ser objetiva, organizada e voltada para resultado: clientes certos, visitas relevantes, oportunidades reais, bom acompanhamento e crescimento sustentável.

Perfil desejado

Profissional com experiência comercial no varejo alimentar, preferencialmente com atuação em supermercados, empórios, distribuidores ou produtos de consumo. Deve ter perfil prático, organizado, relacional e orientado a resultados, com capacidade de abrir portas, negociar e acompanhar a execução no cliente.

Requisitos

  • Experiência em vendas externas ou supervisão comercial no canal varejo.
  • Conhecimento da região Sul: RS, SC e PR.
  • Facilidade de negociação e relacionamento com compradores.
  • Boa organização de agenda, visitas e follow-ups.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens frequentes.
  • CNH ativa.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com café, alimentos, bebidas ou produtos premium.
  • Carteira ativa de clientes no varejo alimentar.
  • Conhecimento de redes regionais, empórios e distribuidores no Sul.
  • Experiência com abertura de novos mercados e expansão regional.

Resumo da posição

Buscamos um profissional comercial para desenvolver o varejo da Baggio Café na região Sul, com foco em abertura de clientes, crescimento de vendas, execução no ponto de venda e construção de relacionamentos comerciais de longo prazo, sempre alinhado à cultura da Baggio Café: mão na massa, qualidade, empreendedorismo, inovação e foco no que importa.

title: Senior International Procurement, Transportantion And Logistics Analyst - English 90%
description:
About the job


The Senior Analyst, International Logistics, serves as a key strategic partner within the Raw Materials Procurement organization, responsible for ensuring the efficient, cost‑effective, and resilient movement of raw materials across the global supply chain. This role combines advanced data analytics with deep logistics expertise to design, optimize, and manage international transportation flows that support production, reduce total landed cost, and strengthen supplier and carrier performance. Serving as a boots‑on‑the‑ground contact, the Senior Analyst drives communication, negotiation, and alignment with both suppliers and transportation providers to ensure operational execution, strategic development and continuous improvement. The Senior Analyst maintains accurate inventory positions through accurate reporting of materials in the supply chain, identifies network inefficiencies, and develops improvement initiatives that enhance service, reduce risk, and support long‑term supply chain competitiveness. Through proactive analysis, cross‑functional collaboration, and continuous process optimization, this position ensures that the company’s global logistics operations are predictable, transparent, and aligned with broader supply chain and business


Scope. Santa Catarina Brazil


objectives


  • Support the efficient and cost‑effective movement of international raw materials by providing accurate data analysis, shipment visibility, and operational coordination.
  • Act as a connector between procurement, logistics, and supplier/carrier partners by translating operational realities and commercial priorities into clear insights and actions.
  • Identify issues and trends, and recommend opportunities for improvement across the international logistics network to strengthen service performance and reduce total landed cost.



What do you need?


To live in Santa Catarina mandatory English 90%

Educational Background: Bachelor of Science in Supply Chain, Business, or a related field, or

equivalent experience.

- Professional Experience: A minimum of 5 years in transportation, international logistics, or

supply chain analytics, with a proven track record of success.

- Detailed knowledge of the North American transportation industry, including LTL, truckload, rail,

warehousing, cross-border, and airfreight

- Knowledge of standard transportation import and export procedures and USDOT requirements

- Advanced experience with transportation pricing methods and practices, customs entry

processes and brokerage/clearance requirements preferred

- Demonstrated experience negotiating commercial terms for both master transportation

agreements and ad hoc projects with carriers, brokers, customs brokers, and rail lines.

- Fundamental understanding of CHEP global operations and business segments preferred

- Thorough understanding of the CHEP network pallet flows and seasonality preferred

Skills and Knowledge - Business Acumen and Problem Solving: Apply knowledge of business rules and processes to

manage organizational tasks efficiently. Utilize strong time management and problem-solving

skills to address challenges effectively



Key Responsibilities May Include:


  • Build and maintain strong relationships with domestic and international carriers, freight forwarders, and suppliers to support reliable and cost‑effective logistics operations.
  • Recommend optimal Incoterms and transportation strategies by assessing risk, cost, and supplier capabilities.
  • Monitor international shipments to maintain accurate daily visibility, escalating delays and risks and supporting timely resolution with carriers, suppliers, and internal teams.
  • Analyze logistics and inventory flow data to identify variances, inefficiencies, and potential cost‑saving or performance‑enhancing opportunities.
  • Prepare regular reporting and dashboards covering shipment status, carrier performance, costs, and inventory impacts to support decision‑making across procurement and operations.
  • Support contract and carrier management activities by gathering performance data, documenting service issues, and contributing to review discussions.
  • Maintain routing guidelines, documentation, and SOPs, helping ensure consistency and accuracy in transportation execution and compliance.
  • Assist with root‑cause investigations into service failures or cost issues, coordinating inputs across carriers, suppliers, and operational stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with planning, sourcing, operations, and transportation teams to ensure alignment on inbound flows, priorities, and risk areas.

investimentos (rebates,mídia, trade digital);

ROI de campanhas e investimentos

  • Prestar consultoria e suporte aos clientes internos: Orientar sobre as regras de negócio dos sistemas em utilização e assegurar que as soluções atendam às suas necessidades.

Requisitos:

  • Experiência mínima de 6 anos como Scrum Master ou analista de desenvolvimento, com atuação em levantamento de requisitos.

  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de gestão ágil, como Azure DevOps.

  • Conhecimento depráticas DevOps (containers, integração e deploy contínuo);

title: Senior Salesforce Developer
description:
Senior Salesforce Developer

Brazil

Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Senior Salesforce Developer with Data Cloud experience to support a strategic initiative focused on reducing customer churn by integrating and enriching customer data across multiple platforms. This role will work closely with the Salesforce Architect, data engineering teams, and cross-functional partners to ingest, unify, and expose data within Salesforce CRM and Salesforce Data 360 (Data Cloud).

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Lead end-to-end ingestion and mapping of customer data from Salesforce CRM, Siebel, Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, and churn model outputs into Salesforce Data 360;
  • Design, build, and maintain identity and account unification rules to produce accurate customer matching and golden records;
  • Create scalable, repeatable pipelines for ingestion, transformation, mapping, and controlled promotion across environments (including Data 360 data kits);
  • Enrich Salesforce CRM records with Data 360 attributes and analytics/model insights (e.G., churn) using related lists, dynamic related lists, and custom UI components;
  • Support CRM data strategy during the Siebel-to-Salesforce migration, prioritizing Salesforce CRM as the system of engagement as adoption increases;
  • Develop and support APIs and integration services for secure internal consumption of Data 360 and CRM data;
    partner with architecture/engineering on integration patterns and implement ETL when native connectors don't meet requirements;
  • Monitor and optimize Data 360 credit consumption to balance cost, performance, and SLAs;
  • Enable businessteams to use enriched customer data for segmentation, activation, and analytics use cases;
  • Document processes, standards, and runbooks;
    contribute to shared enablement resources to drive adoption and operational continuity.

Essential Skills

  • Experience with Salesforce development;
  • Strong proficiency in: Apex, SOQL/SOSL, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Salesforce core data model, Salesforce APIs (REST/SOAP/Bulk), and integration design patterns;
  • Hands-on experience with Data ingestion and harmonization, Identity resolution and unification rules, Data kits and environment promotion, Large-scale data processing;
  • Experience connecting Salesforce Data Cloud/Data 360 to external systems (Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, Siebel, or similar), including when to use native connectors vs. custom integrations;
  • Experience withETL processes and/or tools (e.G., Informatica, MuleSoft, Talend, Databricks);
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams;
  • Strong technical communication skills, able to translate complex concepts for architects, engineers, business users, and leadership;
  • Advanced English to be in contact with customer representative on a daily basis.

Highly Desirable Skills

  • Experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud, especially data activation and segmentation;
  • Experience withSiebel CRM integration and/or data migration;
  • Knowledge of telecom customer data, churn analytics, or Customer 360 implementations;
  • Familiarity with Azure data engineering and Microsoft Fabric connector limitations;
  • Understanding of scalable deployment pipelines and DevOps tooling (Git, CI/CD).

With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora's technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.

title: Technical Support Analyst
description:
We are looking for a highly motivated and detail‐oriented IT Technical Support Engineer to join our ATLAS (Automation of Customer Life Cycle across SAP) team.

In this role, you will play a critical part in supporting the end‐to‐end lifecycle of SAP solution landscapes for enterprise customers — from onboarding through offboarding. You'll work across teams to ensure landscapes are accurately configured, monitored, and transitioned through key lifecycle stages while delivering high‐quality, reliable support.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys problem‐solving, collaboration, and ownership, and who thrives in a fast‐paced, customer‐focused environment.

Your role and responsabilities:

  • Manage and drive resolution of customer issues in collaboration with internal and external support teams
  • Investigate and resolve tickets raised via Jira (and soon ServiceNow)
  • Validate customer landscape configurations, lifecycle statuses, and key milestones using internal tools
  • Identify root causes of discrepancies (e.G., incorrect system statuses, missing dates) and implement corrective actions
  • Coordinate with internal and customer‐facing units (CFUs) to ensure clear ownership and timely resolution
  • Ensure operational data (fulfilment dates, landscape statuses, etc.) is accurate and compliant with internal policies
  • Support reliability and availability efforts aligned with Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles
  • Document solutions and contribute to knowledge bases, process wikis, and operational documentation
  • Mentor new team members during onboarding, feature rollouts, or process changes
  • Recommend process improvements and automation opportunities to enhance efficiency and service quality
  • Create and analyze reports using Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint to track trends and performance metrics

Qualifications and Requirements:

  • Experience in IT Technical Support, customer operations, or enterprise system support
  • Advanced English
  • Exposure to ITSM frameworks (e.G., ITIL)
  • Hands‐on experience supporting at least one cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP)
  • Experience working in or alongside Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) teams
  • Strong analytical and logical thinking skills for troubleshooting complex issues
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills across technical and non‐technical teams
  • Familiarity with ticketing tools such as Jira or ServiceNow
  • Ability to prioritize effectively in a fast‐paced, high‐volume environment
  • A strong sense of ownership with a proactive approach to problem‐solving and process improvement
  • Willingness to learn complex systems and contribute to continuous operational improvement

Nice to Have

  • Understanding of SLA/KPI‐driven operations
  • Familiar with SAP ATLAS
  • Experience supporting enterprise B2B software solutions, ideally SAP‐related.

title: Ar / Billing Analyst
description:
Accounts Receivable / Billing Analyst

Location: Remote (Brazil)

About Sphise Technologies

Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations. Our trusted partner is expanding its financial operations and is seeking a Accounts Receivable / Billing Analyst to support billing processes, invoicing, and accounts receivable activities, ensuring accuracy, efficiency, and timely revenue collection.

Position Overview

We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive AR/Billing Analyst to support billing operations, accounts receivable, and revenue-related processes. This role will be responsible for ensuring accurate invoicing, timely collections, and alignment between contracts and billing execution.

The ideal candidate combines strong attention to detail with hands-on experience in billing and accounts receivable, and is comfortable working cross-functionally to ensure accuracy and efficiency across the quote-to-cash cycle.

What You'll Do

  • Prepare and issue customer invoices accurately and in a timely manner
  • Ensure billing aligns with customer contracts, pricing terms, and invoicing schedules
  • Monitor accounts receivable, track outstanding balances, and follow up on overdue payments
  • Investigate and resolve billing discrepancies and customer inquiries
  • Maintain accurate billing records and supporting documentation
  • Partner with Sales and Customer Success teams to ensure correct contract implementation and billing accuracy
  • Support month-end close activities related to billing and accounts receivable
  • Contribute to improving and streamlining billing and collections processes
  • Assist in optimizing the quote-to-cash workflow
  • Support audits and ensure compliance with billing and financial policies

What You Bring

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field
  • 3–5+ years of experience in accounts receivable, billing, or similar roles
  • Strong understanding of invoicing processes, collections, and revenue fundamentals
  • Experience working cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, or Operations teams
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets
  • Experience with ERP or billing systems (e.G., NetSuite, QuickBooks, SAP) is a plus
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong communication skills, especially when handling client-facing billing matter

Nice to Have

  • Experience with recurring billing models
  • Familiarity with quote-to-cash processes
  • Experience supporting audits and compliance processes
  • Background in process improvement and automation
  • Experience working in high-growth or scaling organizations

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation
  • Fully remote work environment
  • Opportunity to work with modern financial systems and tools
  • Collaborative and fast-growing environment with strong ownership.

Please ensure that your application, including your CV, is submitted in English, as this is a requirement for the recruitment process.

This is a highly sensitive and mission‐critical role with admin‐level access to the core platform. The ideal professional is exceptionally reliable, security‐minded, technically strong, and trustworthy, ensuring the stability, performance, and resilience of cloud infrastructure supporting large‐scale production systems.

You will lead cloud operations, infrastructure automation, observability, and performance optimization across AWS environments, ensuring secure, cost‐efficient, and scalable solutions.

  • Manage and optimize AWS infrastructure including ECS (Fargate & EC2), EC2, RDS/Aurora, S3, IAM, ALB/NLB, Route 53, CloudFront, and WAF;

  • Lead AWS cost‐optimization initiatives, ensuring performance and reliability remain uncompromised;
  • Collaborate with cross‐functional engineering, architecture, and operations teams to support deployments, troubleshoot issues, and evolve platform capabilities;
  • Ensure best‐in‐class security practices for sensitive production environments, including IAM hardening and compliance with internal controls.

Essential Skills

  • Expertise with ECS (Fargate & EC2), EC2, RDS/Aurora, S3, IAM, ALB/NLB, Route 53, CloudFront, and WAF;
  • Strong experience with CloudFormation for managing AWS infrastructure;
  • Hands-on experience with CircleCI or similar tools, including deployment automation and rollback strategies;
  • Proficiency with monitoring and logging tools like New Relic, and Splunk;
  • Ability to identify and resolve performance bottlenecks in database queries, configurations, and infrastructure;
  • Experience reducing AWS costs while maintaining or improving system reliability and performans.

Highly Desirable Skills

  • Hands-on experience operating Amazon Aurora MySQL/Postgres in production environments, including version upgrade procedures, performance tuning, and troubleshooting;
  • Strong understanding of Aurora architecture, read replicas, automated backups, point-in-time recovery, failover mechanisms, and high availability patterns;

title: Strategic Partnership & Alliance
description:
About RateGain

RateGain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered SaaS solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. RateGain today is one of the world's largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.

Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today RateGain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.

Exploring the role

RateGain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world's largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, RateGain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.

The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond.

This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. This position can be based anywhere in Latam and needs to have the ability to travel within the Latam without limitations.

How your day will look like/Job responsibility

  • Build and manage strategic alliances with regional and local partners (e.G. RMS, PMS, booking engines, OTAs)
  • Define and execute a partnership roadmap aligned with RateGain's GTM strategy in LATAM
  • Identify co-marketing, co-selling, and integration opportunities with key players in the hospitality and travel ecosystem
  • Collaborate with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Product, Legal) to structure and execute partnership agreements
  • Represent RateGain in industry events and partnership meetings to promote our brand and solutions
  • Monitor partner performance, engagement, and contribution to pipeline and revenue
  • Provide regular reporting and insights on partnership outcomes and market trends

Education & Work Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in business, Marketing, or a related field
  • 5+ years of experience in business development or strategic partnerships

Knowledge:

  • In-depth understanding of the LATAM hospitality and travel technology ecosystem
  • Knowledge of SaaS business models and partnership structures
  • Awareness of regional trends, customer behavior, and competitive landscape in the travel and hospitality sectors

Skills:

  • Strong negotiation and deal-closing capabilities
  • Excellent relationship management skills with ability to engage partners at all levels
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills in Spanish, Portuguese, and English
  • Ability to identify, pitch, and convert strategic partnership opportunities
  • Proficiency in using CRM and sales enablement tools
  • Skilled in cross-functional collaboration with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Legal, Product, etc.)

Attitude:

  • Proactive and results-oriented, with a strong drive to exceed targets
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for growth and innovation
  • Culturally sensitive and collaborative, with the ability to work effectively in a global, remote team
  • High level of integrity, professionalism, and ownership
  • Resilient and adaptable in a fast-paced and evolving environment

title: Emerging Market Trader
description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.

Key Responsibilities

FX Trading & Liquidity Management

  • Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies, with a focus on African (e.G., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS) or LATAM (e.G., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS) markets.
  • Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions.
  • Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure.
  • Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets.

Hedging Strategy & Risk Management

  • Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures.
  • Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant.
  • Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization.
  • Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books.

Trading Infrastructure & Systems

  • Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure, including:
  • Automated hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation systems
  • Smart order routing
  • Pricing and risk management tools

  • LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS

Skills

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations.

  • Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations.
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills
  • Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments

Vision & Mission

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain's "killer app," with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.

We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Product Owner Sênior
description:
Estamos em busca de um Product Owner Sênior para liderar a evolução de produtos digitais no segmento de saúde, com forte proximidade das rotinas médicas, jornadas de consulta, fluxos clínicos e necessidades reais dos médicos e times assistenciais.

Esse profissional será responsável por atuar como elo entre negócio, tecnologia, usuários e stakeholders, garantindo que as decisões de produto gerem valor para a operação, melhorem a experiência dos profissionais de saúde e pacientes, e sustentem os objetivos estratégicos da organização.

O perfil ideal combina sólida experiência em produto com capacidade de entender a dinâmica do ambiente de saúde, especialmente a lógica por trás de consultas médicas, documentação clínica, jornadas assistenciais, gargalos operacionais e usabilidade para o médico no dia a dia.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Gerenciar e priorizar o backlog do produto, garantindo alinhamento com os objetivos do negócio e as necessidades dos usuários.
  • Traduzir objetivos estratégicos em requisitos claros, épicos, histórias de usuário e critérios de aceitação.
  • Atuar em parceria com stakeholders das áreas de saúde, operação, negócio, tecnologia, UX e dados.
  • Entender e mapear fluxos ponta a ponta do ambiente de saúde, incluindo consultas, agendamentos, prontuários, documentação clínica e rotinas de apoio ao médico.
  • Levantar necessidades diretamente com usuários, especialmente médicos, equipes clínicas e times operacionais.
  • Identificar dores nas rotinas médicas e administrativas, transformando essas necessidades em oportunidades de produto.
  • Priorizar funcionalidades com base em valor de negócio, impacto para o usuário, viabilidade técnica e urgência.
  • Participar ativamente das cerimônias ágeis, apoiando o time com direcionamento funcional e esclarecimento contínuo de requisitos.
  • Garantir que o produto entregue eficiência operacional, boa usabilidade, adoção e resultados mensuráveis.
  • Conduzir ou apoiar atividades de discovery, como entrevistas, análise de fluxos, validações e testes de hipótese.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com times de engenharia e design para construir soluções práticas e centradas no usuário.
  • Acompanhar indicadores de desempenho do produto, métricas de uso, feedbacks e resultados operacionais.
  • Promover a melhoria contínua dos produtos, equilibrando necessidades regulatórias, operacionais e de experiência do usuário.
  • Atuar como principal referência da squad em decisões de escopo, priorização e direcionamento funcional.

Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência comprovada como Product Owner, Product Owner Sênior ou função equivalente em produto.
  • Vivência sólida em ambientes ágeis, com atuação junto a squads multidisciplinares.
  • Experiência no segmento de saúde, healthtech, operações clínicas, sistemas médicos ou contextos correlatos.
  • Forte compreensão de fluxos de saúde, especialmente relacionados a consultas médicas, rotina do médico, agendamentos, jornada do paciente e necessidades assistenciais.
  • Capacidade de compreender o que o médico precisa em termos de sistema, processo e usabilidade, mesmo quando a demanda não vem totalmente estruturada.
  • Experiência na escrita de histórias de usuário, definição de critérios de aceitação e gestão estruturada de backlog.
  • Habilidade de relacionamento e gestão de stakeholders.
  • Capacidade de conectar estratégia de negócio com execução de produto e entrega de tecnologia.
  • Perfil analítico, com capacidade de usar dados, evidências e feedbacks para apoiar priorização e tomada de decisão.
  • Capacidade de atuar em ambientes complexos, com múltiplos stakeholders e mudanças de prioridade.

Requisitos desejáveis

  • Experiência prévia com produtos relacionados a: prontuário eletrônico,
  • agendamento de consultas, telemedicina, otimização de fluxo clínico, portais médicos, jornada do paciente, coordenação do cuidado, plataformas assistenciais.
  • Familiaridade com requisitos regulatórios, privacidade e compliance no setor de saúde.
  • Experiência com integrações entre sistemas de saúde e interoperabilidade.
  • Vivência com médicos, clínicas, hospitais, centros diagnósticos ou operações assistenciais.
  • Experiência com discovery e desenho de serviços em contexto de saúde.
  • Conhecimento de métricas relacionadas à eficiência clínica, fluxo de atendimento, adoção e performance operacional.

Competências esperadas

  • Forte senso de dono sobre o produto
  • Excelente capacidade de priorização
  • Visão de negócio com foco no usuário
  • Capacidade de lidar com ambiguidade e transformar demandas em backlog acionável
  • Escuta ativa e boa facilitação
  • Empatia com médicos, pacientes e equipes operacionais
  • Comunicação clara com públicos técnicos e não técnicos
  • Pensamento estruturado para solução de problemas
  • Tomada de decisão orientada a valor e impacto
  • Alto nível de autonomia e accountability

O que esperamos de sucesso nessa posição

  • O roadmap do produto reflita prioridades reais do negócio e da operação em saúde.
  • Médicos e usuários clínicos percebam que o produto apoia, e não dificulta, a rotina do dia a dia.
  • Os requisitos estejam claros o suficiente para permitir execução eficiente pelo time de tecnologia.
  • As entregas gerem ganhos concretos de eficiência, qualidade operacional, adoção e experiência do usuário.
  • A squad tenha clareza sobre prioridades, contexto e objetivos de negócio.

Diferencial importante

Buscamos alguém que não apenas conheça produto, mas que tenha sensibilidade para entender a lógica do ambiente médico, conseguindo traduzir necessidades assistenciais e operacionais em soluções digitais de alto valor.

Missão do cargo

Desenvolver, manter e evoluir soluções com qualidade, usabilidade, desempenho e inovação, dentro dos prazos acordados, com supervisão mínima;
tendo como foco a evolução da gestão em nossos clientes.

Todas as nossas vagas estão disponíveis para pessoas com deficiência!

Que tal se juntar ao nosso time e embarcar nessa jornada com a gente?

  • Interpretar requisitos funcionais criando vínculos entre estes e as modificações necessárias na solução;

  • Criar ajustes emelhorias que visem aumentar o desempenho (Tunning);
  • Executar manutenção corretiva, evolutiva e adaptativa em código e rotinas pré-existentes
  • Realizar revisão das tarefas de seus pares;
  • Realizar mentoring e acompanhamento de novos membros da equipe;
  • Liderar colegasem projetos que envolvam vários desenvolvedores;
  • Tomar decisões rápidas e assertivas acerca de problemas técnicos encontrados em projetos e/ou manutenção das soluções;

  • Realizar o apontamento das atividades no sistema de controle da produção da empresa.
  • Utilizar ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial no dia a dia de engenharia para apoio em diagnóstico de problemas, revisão de código, documentação técnica e aceleração de entregas, garantindo uso responsável e seguro das informações.

Desejável:

title: English Teacher
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.

If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you're looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we've got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.

What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!

In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:

  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.

Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Especialista Em Plant Simulation (Pj)
description:
Buscamos um Especialista em Plant Simulation para liderar a criação de gêmeos digitais (Digital Twins) e modelos de simulação de eventos discretos. Você será a ponte entre a engenharia industrial e a tomada de decisão estratégica, testando cenários virtuais para otimizar o fluxo de produção, reduzir gargalos e validar novos investimentos antes que eles saiam do papel.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Modelagem e Simulação: Desenvolver modelos dinâmicos de alta complexidade utilizando o software Tecnomatix Plant Simulation.
  • Análise de Gargalos e Otimização: Analisar fluxos de materiais, capacidade de armazenamento, utilização de recursos (máquinas e operadores) e logística interna.
  • Programação SimTalk: Criar lógicas personalizadas e métodos avançados de controle utilizando a linguagem de programação nativa do software (SimTalk 2.0).
  • Validação de Cenários (What-if): Propor e testar alterações de layout, mix de produtos e novas tecnologias (como AGVs/AMRs) reportando o ROI das mudanças.
  • Integração de Dados: Conectar os modelos de simulação com bancos de dados (SQL, Oracle), planilhas e outros sistemas corporativos (ERP, MES, PLM).
  • Apresentação de Resultados: Traduzir dados técnicos de simulação em relatórios claros e dashboards para a diretoria e gerentes de planta.

Requisitos e Qualificações

O que você precisa ter (Essencial):

  • Ensino superior completo em Engenharia (Produção, Mecânica, Mecatrônica, Controle e Automação) ou Ciência da Computação / áreas correlatas.
  • Sólida experiência prática com o Siemens Tecnomatix Plant Simulation.
  • Domínio de programação em SimTalk.
  • Conhecimento forte em Estatística aplicada à simulação (distribuições de probabilidade, validação de dados de entrada e análise de saída).
  • Visão de Processos Industriais (Lean Manufacturing, tempos e métodos, gargalos).

O que vai te destacar (Diferencial):

  • Conhecimento em outras ferramentas Siemens (Process Simulate, NX MCD, Teamcenter).
  • Experiência com linguagens de programação adicionais (Python, C++, SQL).
  • Experiência com emulação (comissionamento virtual conectando o modelo a PLCs reais).

Contratação: PJ.

title: Technical Product Owner
description:
ABOUT US

Syniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world's largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.

Syniti's Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy.

Operating globally across industries, Syniti's award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.

Syniti's cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.

THE ROLE

We are seeking a highly technical and execution‐driven Technical Product Owner to serve as the "engine room" of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‐level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‐native, AI‐driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the "Golden Record" through seamless end‐to‐end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance.

What You'll Do

  • Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions.
  • Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios.
  • UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‐class workflows within SKP.
  • Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‐functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value.
  • Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define "What Good Looks Like." Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‐world user behavior.
  • Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage.

WHAT IT TAKES

  • The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure).
  • The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance "plumbing." Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus.
  • The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication.
  • The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‐zone teams.
  • The Academic: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience.
  • The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams.

Key Skills

  • Visionary Leadership: Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals.
  • Advanced Governance Concepts: Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules.
  • AI/ML Application: Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‐matching or data‐cleansing logic.
  • Visual Communication: Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment.
  • Technical Storyboarding: Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity.
  • Relationship Orchestration: Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement.
  • Drive for Results: Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‐moving environment.

Be fully aligned with our core values:

Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don't know they have.

Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.

Take Action - Be the first. Don't wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.

Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.

By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing.
  • Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.
  • Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won't stand alone.
  • Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all.
  • Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.
  • An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone's work is seen, and ideas are valued.

OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION

At Syniti, we're committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team.

We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we're dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we're here to support you.

title: Customer Operations & Finance Support
description:

Your role and responsabilities:

  • Create, update, and manage customer data within internal ITIL tools to support end‐to‐end service workflows
  • Own and manage the financial health of customer accounts, including:
  • Monthly Balance Sheet preparation & review
  • Account reconciliations
  • P&L analysis and variance explanations
  • Perform financial analysis and reporting to support business and management decisions
  • Lead customer onboarding and offboarding for SAP ECS accounts, coordinating with cross‐functional stakeholders
  • Work directly with Premium Customers, ensuring a high‐quality, reliable service experience
  • Monitor customer service metrics, analyze trends, and take proactive actions to improve delivery
  • Measure, track, and improve overall customer experience levels

  • Support management with forecasting, budgeting, and performance tracking vs. plan
  • Lead and support customer service teams through transitions, service introductions, or operational changes
  • Collaborate closely with senior management to align customer service outcomes with company goals

What You Bring

  • Experience working in an Operations Support model
  • Advanced English
  • Strong experience in frontline customer management, including executive‐level interactions
  • Proven experience managing Finance & Accounting aspects of customer accounts
  • Hands‐on experience with ITIL processes, including:
  • Incident Management
  • Service Request Management
  • Change Management
  • Excellent analytical and problem‐solving skills
  • High attention to detail and accuracy in financial data analysis and reporting
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a team
  • Experience working in a multinational or cross‐cultural environment

Nice to Have

  • Project management experience in service transition and/or service introduction
  • Experience with common customer service and ITSM tools
  • Exposure to enterprise or SAP‐based customer environments

Please submit resumé in English

title: English Teacher With Advanced Portuguese Skills
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.

Whether you're looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we've got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!

title: Data Project Manager (Remote)

  • Conduzir cerimônias ágeis (dailies, sprints, retrospectivas) e adaptar frameworks (Scrum, Kanban, híbrido) conforme o contexto.
  • Atuar como interface entre times técnicos e áreas de negócio, traduzindo demandas em planos de execução claros.

  • Inglês fluente (interação constante com times e stakeholders internacionais).

Diferenciais

  • Uso de soluções de IA como aceleradores de entrega.
  • Conhecimento em SQL para validações básicas.

title: Ai Automation Specialist
description:
Hey, Dingus!

Yep, you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we're on the hunt for a sharp, systems-minded AI Automation Specialist who can build, connect, and scale intelligent workflows that actually work in production.

About Us

Dingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an "unlimited get-shit-done" subscription for our clients, from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.

Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.

What You'll Do

  • Build and maintain automated workflows using N8N, connecting APIs, webhooks, and data sources into seamless pipelines.
  • Integrate and prompt Claude (Anthropic) and other LLMs into production systems, not just experiments.
  • Manage and automate data operations in Airtable, including scripted fields, automations, and structured data pipelines.
  • Design AI-assisted workflows that reduce manual effort across client delivery, internal ops, and content production.
  • Troubleshoot broken pipelines, handle edge cases, and document systems so they don't live only in your head.
  • Collaborate with strategy and delivery teams to identify automation opportunities and scope builds accurately.
  • Stay current on the AI tooling landscape, you should know what's worth using before we ask.
  • Own and iterate on AI agent logic and system prompts, understanding why a workflow behaves the way it does and improving it over time.
  • Build net-new internal AI tools as the business identifies opportunities, not just maintain what exists.

What You Bring

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience building automated workflows (N8N, Make.Com, or Zapier, N8N strongly preferred).
  • Real experience integrating LLMs via API (Claude, GPT, or equivalent) into production pipelines with structured outputs.
  • Proficiency in Airtable as a data layer, scripting, automations, relational structures.
  • Solid understanding of REST APIs, JSON, and webhook-based integrations.
  • Basic scripting ability in Python or JavaScript, enough to write and debug function nodes without hand-holding.
  • A working understanding of HTML and CSS is imperative, you need to be able to read, interpret, and make sense of front-end structure when workflows touch web-based outputs.
  • A systems thinker mindset: you design the whole loop, not just the happy path.
  • Ability to work independently in a fully remote, fast-paced environment.
  • Comfort with versioning and testing AI outputs, you notice when a prompt change breaks something and know how to fix it.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with vector databases or basic RAG pipelines (Pinecone, Supabase, etc.).
  • Familiarity with AI agent frameworks (LangChain, or equivalent concepts).
  • Experience in a digital agency or client-services environment.
  • Exposure to prompt engineering best practices, like system prompts, chaining, few-shot design.

Work Details

  • Hours: 9 A.M. – 5 P.M. MST, Monday to Friday
  • Requires a working level of written and spoken English

If you're someone who can look at a messy manual process, see the system hiding inside it, and build something that runs without you, we want to hear from you.

Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

title: Software Engineer Iii
description:

  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e capacidade de se comunicar com diferentes públicos, incluindo gerentes de produto, clientes e engenheiros de software
  • Curiosidade para entender e analisar problemas, pensar criticamente e propor soluções
  • Habilidade de colaboração remota em equipes distribuídas

title: Senior International Procurement, Transportantion And Logistics Analyst - English 90%
description:
About the job

The Senior Analyst, International Logistics, serves as a key strategic partner within the Raw Materials Procurement organization, responsible for ensuring the efficient, cost‐effective, and resilient movement of raw materials across the global supply chain. This role combines advanced data analytics with deep logistics expertise to design, optimize, and manage international transportation flows that support production, reduce total landed cost, and strengthen supplier and carrier performance. Serving as a boots‐on‐the‐ground contact, the Senior Analyst drives communication, negotiation, and alignment with both suppliers and transportation providers to ensure operational execution, strategic development and continuous improvement. The Senior Analyst maintains accurate inventory positions through accurate reporting of materials in the supply chain, identifies network inefficiencies, and develops improvement initiatives that enhance service, reduce risk, and support long‐term supply chain competitiveness. Through proactive analysis, cross‐functional collaboration, and continuous process optimization, this position ensures that the company's global logistics operations are predictable, transparent, and aligned with broader supply chain and business

Scope. Santa Catarina Brazil

objectives

  • Support the efficient and cost‐effective movement of international raw materials by providing accurate data analysis, shipment visibility, and operational coordination.
  • Act as a connector between procurement, logistics, and supplier/carrier partners by translating operational realities and commercial priorities into clear insights and actions.
  • Identify issues and trends, and recommend opportunities for improvement across the international logistics network to strengthen service performance and reduce total landed cost.

What do you need?

To live in Santa Catarina mandatory English 90%

Educational Background: Bachelor of Science in Supply Chain, Business, or a related field, or

equivalent experience.

- Professional Experience: A minimum of 5 years in transportation, international logistics, or

supply chain analytics, with a proven track record of success.

- Detailed knowledge of the North American transportation industry, including LTL, truckload, rail,

warehousing, cross-border, and airfreight

- Knowledge of standard transportation import and export procedures and USDOT requirements

- Advanced experience with transportation pricing methods and practices, customs entry

processes and brokerage/clearance requirements preferred

- Demonstrated experience negotiating commercial terms for both master transportation

agreements and ad hoc projects with carriers, brokers, customs brokers, and rail lines.

- Fundamental understanding of CHEP global operations and business segments preferred

- Thorough understanding of the CHEP network pallet flows and seasonality preferred

Skills and Knowledge - Business Acumen and Problem Solving: Apply knowledge of business rules and processes to

manage organizational tasks efficiently. Utilize strong time management and problem-solving

skills to address challenges effectively

Key Responsibilities May Include:

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with domestic and international carriers, freight forwarders, and suppliers to support reliable and cost‐effective logistics operations.
  • Recommend optimal Incoterms and transportation strategies by assessing risk, cost, and supplier capabilities.
  • Monitor international shipments to maintain accurate daily visibility, escalating delays and risks and supporting timely resolution with carriers, suppliers, and internal teams.
  • Analyze logistics and inventory flow data to identify variances, inefficiencies, and potential cost‐saving or performance‐enhancing opportunities.
  • Prepare regular reporting and dashboards covering shipment status, carrier performance, costs, and inventory impacts to support decision‐making across procurement and operations.
  • Support contract and carrier management activities by gathering performance data, documenting service issues, and contributing to review discussions.
  • Maintain routing guidelines, documentation, and SOPs, helping ensure consistency and accuracy in transportation execution and compliance.
  • Assist with root‐cause investigations into service failures or cost issues, coordinating inputs across carriers, suppliers, and operational stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with planning, sourcing, operations, and transportation teams to ensure alignment on inbound flows, priorities, and risk areas.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
We are seeking a full-time, remote Senior Data Engineer with 5+ years of experience to join our U.S. client's software engineering team. This key individual should have experience making decisions, working on a small development team, and working both independently and as part of a small, dynamic team where everything you do makes a difference.

The industry-leading client provides business-automating, enterprise resource planning (ERP) accounting software for the oil & gas industry. The client's software and services streamline and automate complex processes, such as revenue distribution, billing, order management, production accounting, accounts payable, contract management, and more, for over 1,700 customers across 9 countries.

The senior-level position will be part of the client's Intelligence team. This business intelligence solution brings data from multiple products onto one platform, enabling analysis and data-driven insights. Responsibilities will focus on designing, building, and maintaining scalable data pipelines and infrastructure that converts raw data into a format ready for ingestion by a BI tool. The individual will coordinate with the implementation team to provide on-time deliverables, quality products, and exceptional customer service.

Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain scalable data pipelines that power clients' products, which support core product functionality, customer reporting, and internal analytics.
  • Take end‐to‐end ownership of data flows, from ingestion to delivery, with a focus on data quality and reliability.
  • Create and maintain production‐grade database views and transformation logic.
  • Develop, optimize, and manage SQL view scripts and transformations.
  • Design, configure, and maintain database architectures, distributed systems, and data storage solutions.
  • Ensure data integrity by implementing validation processes for data accuracy, consistency, and reliability.
  • Monitor system performance, troubleshoot issues, and optimize data queries and workflows for efficiency.
  • Build and support data integrations with internal services and third‐party APIs, managing authentication, schema evolution, rate limits, and error handling. Proactively adapt pipelines as client products and customer needs grow.
  • Research and recommend innovative approaches for project execution. Recommend areas for improvement in internal processes along with possible solutions, providing status reports to stakeholders, and addressing issues as appropriate.
  • Participate with the team in problem resolution regarding systems and procedures. Assists the team or supervisor in identifying data anomalies and providing business solutions.
  • Document procedures using text, workflow diagrams, and screenshots from the application. Develops and maintains installations and configuration procedures. Provides documentation for institutional workflow processes associated with the application.

Required Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Finance, Accounting, or related field
  • Excellent English verbal and written communication skills
  • 5+ years of data engineering experience
  • 3+ years SQL and Python experience
  • Knowledge of database architecture and management
  • Experience working with Cloud Platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP, etc.)
  • Ability to read code and convert programming logic from one language to another
  • Familiarity with APIs

Preferred Experience

  • Experience working with data analytics tools (e.G., Power BI, QuickSight, Looker, Sisense)
  • Experience with Apache Airflow
  • Experience with AI coding tools and/or AI assistants
  • Background in Math, Stats, Machine Learning

Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

About The Methodical Group

The Methodical Group (methodicalgroup.Com) is a leading global provider of IT Services, Consulting, and Specialized Staffing Solutions, operating with a systematic, high-quality approach for over 25 years. Headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida, we use proprietary frameworks, such as ExactTalent, to provide specialized workforce solutions, including permanent placement and contract staffing, across industries such as IT and Healthcare. Simultaneously, our IT and Business Services division offers expert solutions in Software Development, Data & Analytics, and IT Operations, aiming to help organizations worldwide drive digital transformation, improve efficiency, and maintain a competitive edge.

About the Opportunity

Our client is seeking an Implementation Analyst to support their Professional Services team, leading end-to-end deployments of a SaaS platform across municipal government clients. This role combines project leadership, client engagement, and product expertise—guiding customers through configuration, setup, data migration, and training to ensure successful system adoption.

The Implementation Analyst will work closely with clients to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable system solutions, ensuring each customer realizes measurable value while delivering a seamless and high-quality onboarding experience.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the full implementation lifecycle for new customers, from kickoff through go-live, managing multiple concurrent implementations for small-to-mid-sized municipal clients.
  • Conduct discovery sessions to gather business requirements, workflows, and success metrics, translating them into system configurations.
  • Configure and customize the SaaS platform based on client-specific use cases while maintaining best practices and scalability.
  • Coordinate with Data Engineers on data imports and integrations, performing QA testing to validate functionality and data integrity prior to go-live.
  • Deliver customer training sessions to ensure user adoption and proficiency across departments.
  • Monitor project timelines, proactively managing scope, risks, dependencies, and overall project health.
  • Document configurations, implementation decisions, and knowledge base materials to support consistency and scalability.
  • Collaborate with Product, Support, and Customer Success teams to ensure smooth transition and ongoing client success post-launch.
  • Identify opportunities for process improvement and recommend best practices to optimize future implementations.

Qualifications

  • At least 2 years of Professional Services or Implementation experience supporting Enterprise SaaS products.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • Strong understanding of SaaS platforms, cloud environments, and data management principles.
  • Working knowledge of data concepts such as file formats, field mapping, and data validation, with the ability to coordinate effectively with technical teams.
  • Experience using tools such as Wrike, HubSpot, Salesforce, Jira, or similar implementation and project tracking platforms.
  • Proven experience working directly with clients and managing multiple implementation projects simultaneously.
  • Ability to manage client relationships professionally, set expectations, and communicate effectively throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Strong ability to translate technical concepts into clear, business-friendly language.
  • Excellent problem-solving, analytical, communication, organizational, and time-management skills.
  • Ability to quickly learn new technologies, tools, and business domains.

title: Area Sales Manager (Santa Catarina State)
description:
Ecorobotix SA. creates innovative robotic solutions that reduce the negative ecological impact of modern agriculture. We have developed an AI-based ultra-high precision spot spraying technology that drastically reduces the amount of chemicals used in crop fields while keeping costs competitive. The technology is currently deployed on our tractor towed ARA machine. By joining our talented and dynamic team, you will contribute to a more sustainable, environment-friendly agriculture in an innovative scale-up at the cutting edge of technology. We are a revolutionary organization with a great work environment that supports creativity through self-motivation.

To pursue our growth in Brazil, we are hiring an experienced entrepreneurial mind based in Santa Catarina State for an:

Area Sales Manager

General objective of the role

As an Area Sales Manager of the Ecorobotix SA. Team, you will be responsible for managing and expanding the sales of agricultural machinery within a designated region. The role involves overseeing existing dealer relationships, optimizing dealer performance, and driving new business opportunities by identifying future dealers and customers as well as driving revenue growth. The Area Sales Manager will work closely with dealers to ensure product availability, support, and training, ensuring the company's agricultural machinery is effectively marketed and sold. This position requires a leader with a deep understanding of market dynamics, strong leadership skills, and the ability to foster a results-oriented sales culture within the region.

Reporting lines and interactions

This role reports directly to the Commercial Director. Internally, you will closely collaborate with other members of the Sales team and other teams of Ecorobotix. Externally, you will interact with dealers, farmers, partners, associations, trade shows, Agronomists, and CCA's.

A day in the life of an Area Sales Manager

The Area Sales Manager will travel across the designated territory to visit key accounts, meet new prospects, and support dealer partners. Whether you're pulling into a grower's yard or a dealership lot, you're the face of a cutting-edge ag-tech company that's reshaping the future of precision spraying.

You will showcase how our high-precision sprayer delivers real ROI: less chemical waste, more targeted application, and better yields. You walk growers through the technology— highlighting features like variable rate spraying and intelligent targeting—while grounding every conversation in real-world impact. You sit down and dig into the potential customer's specific challenges and help them see how the product fits into their operation. You're not just selling equipment;
you're helping solve problems.

"You're part field representative, part storyteller, part strategist. You're a trusted advisor selling value, not just hardware."

Key Responsibilities

  • Identify and prospect new customers across Brazil, managing all communication and driving the sales process through to contract signature.
  • Engage with customers to understand their needs and provide tailored solutions, ensuring strong order generation and relationship development.
  • Assess customer solvency, share pricing information, negotiate terms, and suggest improvements to optimize pricing strategies.
  • Provide training and ongoing support to partners, while identifying opportunities for expanding and strengthening the partner network.
  • Actively participate in industry fairs, customer demos, and events to increase visibility and drive engagement in the region.
  • Foster collaboration and support within the distributor network to drive sales and enhance product reach.
  • Create compelling content in collaboration with the marketing team to support campaigns and enhance brand presence.

Qualifications

  • Master's degree in Sales and/or Agronomy, or related field.
  • 10+ years of experience in sales and hands-on experience in agriculture, ag-tech, or precision equipment.
  • Willingness to travel domestically in Brazil.

Must-Have

  • Experience in Ag-tech or chemical distribution.
  • Knowledge in Agronomy related to weeding in field crops.

Your Assets

  • Excellent communication and leadership skills, willingness to build relationships with customers.
  • Exceptional written and verbal presentation skills, with clear & consistent communication.
  • High degree of independence, reliability, and spirit of initiative.
  • Driven individual with systematic, goal-oriented working methods.
  • Computer skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and CRM tools.
  • Strong organizational and multi-tasking skills
  • Team-player

description:
Grupo Smart Fit, a força que ativa o seu potencial.

O Grupo Smart Fit é a maior plataforma de fitness e bem-estar da América Latina e um dos grupos que mais crescem no mundo. Com atuação em mais de 16 países, mais de 2.000 unidades, mais de 23 mil colaboradores e um ecossistema completo de marcas, impactamos milhões de pessoas todos os dias por meio de experiências que promovem saúde, movimento e qualidade de vida.

Aqui, fazer parte do time é crescer junto. Buscamos pessoas que queiram treinar para evoluir sempre, assumir protagonismo na carreira e construir uma trajetória sólida dentro de um grupo forte, em constante expansão e movimento.

Trabalhar no Grupo Smart Fit é levar na carreira a força de um grande grupo global, com visão de longo prazo, estrutura robusta e oportunidades reais de crescimento, mobilidade entre marcas e novos desafios ao longo da jornada.

Tudo isso em uma cultura de alta performance, forte, colaborativa e conectada ao nosso propósito. Nosso ecossistema reúne marcas que atuam em diferentes frentes do fitness e bem-estar: academias como Smart Fit, Bio Ritmo e Nation CT;
studios como Race Bootcamp, Vidya Studio, Jab House, Tonus Gym, Aera Pilates, Velocity e Kore;
e produtos digitais, TotalPass e Queima Diária.

Principais responsabilidades:

1. Liderança Técnica e Arquitetura

  • Guardião da Base de Código: Definir e zelar pelos padrões de código ("The Rails Way"), garantindo que a API seja sólida para os projetos Web e Mobile.
  • Tomada de Decisão Técnica: Escolher as melhores tecnologias, bibliotecas e padrões que equilibrem rapidez de entrega com sustentabilidade futura.
  • Apoio à Gestão: Ser o braço direito do Gerente de TI e do GP, ajudando na estimativa de prazos, viabilidade de features e priorização técnica do backlog.

2. Qualidade, Integração e Homologação

  • Garantia de Eficiência no Processo: Homologar as integrações da API com os times de Front-end (Web e Mobile), garantindo que os contratos de dados sejam cumpridos e a performance seja máxima.
  • Revisão de Código (Code Review): Liderar as revisões de código dos parceiros, assegurando que nenhum débito técnico crítico entre em produção.
  • Estratégia de Testes: Definir a política de cobertura de testes e garantir que o time utilize mocks e ferramentas como VCR para manter a agilidade no desenvolvimento.

3. Sustentação, Suporte e Performance

  • Atendimento de Chamados Nível 3: Atuar como ponto focal em problemas complexos de produção, realizando a análise de causa raiz e orientando o time na correção definitiva.
  • Otimização Contínua: Monitorar gargalos de performance no servidor e no banco de dados, implementando melhorias proativas para suportar o crescimento do app.

4. Aprendizado e Melhoria Contínua

  • Radar Tecnológico: Manter o time atualizado com as novas versões do Ruby e do Rails, avaliando quando migrar ou adotar novas práticas.
  • Cultura de Inovação Pragmática: Estimular o uso de ferramentas de IA para ganho de produtividade, sem abrir mão da segurança e da qualidade do código.

O que buscamos

Pessoas que:

  • Dominem Arquitetura de Sistemas com Ruby on Rails: Domínio profundo de Rails em modo API e Monolitos, com habilidade para desenhar arquiteturas escaláveis, modulares e de fácil manutenção.
  • Têm experiência com Design de APIs e Contratos: Expertise em arquitetura RESTful, versionamento e, principalmente, na definição de contratos de dados que atendam de forma eficiente Web e Mobile.
  • Têm experiência com Engenharia de Testes Avançada: Domínio total de RSpec, incluindo estratégias complexas de mocking com VCR e WebMock, garantindo pipelines de CI/CD rápidos e determinísticos.
  • Têm experiência com Modelagem e Performance de Dados: Maestria em PostgreSQL, otimização de queries, gestão de índices e estratégias de cache (Redis) para suportar aplicações de alta performance.
  • Têm experiência com Segurança e Infraestrutura: Conhecimento sólido em protocolos de segurança (OAuth2, JWT), além de familiaridade com Docker e ambientes de deploy (AWS/Heroku/DigitalOcean).
  • Adotem estrategicamente a IA: Capacidade de liderar o time no uso eficiente de ferramentas como GitHub Copilot ou Cursor para acelerar a geração de código, testes e documentação.
  • Tenham pragmatismo e visão de Negócio: Foco em entregar a melhor solução técnica que respeite os prazos e objetivos da empresa, evitando "overengineering".
  • Tenham Liderança e Mentoria: Capacidade de elevar o nível técnico dos devs Plenos e Juniores através de Code Reviews educativos e suporte constante.
  • Tenham Comunicação Estratégica e Proativa: Habilidade de traduzir requisitos de negócio (GP) em tarefas técnicas e alinhar expectativas com os times de Front/Mobile para evitar bloqueios.
  • Têm experiência com Gestão de Crises e Decisão: Calma e assertividade para tomar decisões técnicas difíceis sob pressão e resolver incidentes críticos em produção.
  • Tenham Atitude de Dono: Comprometimento total com a qualidade do produto final, antecipando gargalos e propondo melhorias antes que se tornem problemas.
